views.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create detailed natural 16:9 watercolor game background preview for The Grand Tour scene 21 PRASAT KRAVAN / 豆蔻寺, frontal five-brick-tower group. Reference 1 is sole architecture, composition and condition source: APSARA official original https://apsaraauthority.gov.kh/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/APSARA-Authority_Angkor-Temple_-Kravan-Temple_Angkor-Temple_Siem-Reap.jpg-16.jpg . Reference 2 approved Thommanon watercolor is STYLE ONLY, never borrow architecture. Faithfully paint these FIVE tightly spaced brick shrines on one long low stepped platform: tall central tiered tapering tower with photographed truncated top and blind arches, shorter surviving tiered tower at far left, the other three low roofless rectangular sanctuaries exactly as visible, unequal silhouettes retained. Preserve pale conserved brick infill contrasted with old dark weathered brick, actual dark sandstone lintels and rectangular door surrounds, dark central opening, low worn steps and real small eroded guardian remains along platform edge. Do not complete lost tower tops or make all five equally tall, no speculative reconstruction, no extra towers, carved stone temples or Bayon faces. Trees rise behind both sides, pale overcast blue-grey sky, grass and three simple approach strips across low foreground. Keep exact front perspective and tower relative proportions, all shrines and tops visible; adapt 3:2 to 16:9 by cropping excess empty sky and minimally extending grass/trees only, never stretching buildings. Retain existing central doorway barrier but omit small lettered notice and translucent watermark. Gentle natural daylight, warm rusty brick, warm grey sandstone, nuanced greens, precise fine masonry and leaf brushwork, transparent watercolor layers, subtle cotton paper texture, excellent depth. Match approved detailed travel picture-book series, not loose blurry washes, thick outlines, photorealism or photo filter. No people, characters, lettering, sign, logo, UI or frame. Preserve archived conservation state.
